statement.zh: 德罗德罗、纳莱塔莱等晚期石址把津巴布韦文化延续到大津巴布韦衰落之后。
statement.en: Later stone ruins such as Dhlo Dhlo and Naletale extend Zimbabwe Culture after Great Zimbabwe’s decline.
